description: Telemetry consent as the `telemetry` capability. The record stays where every SDK already reads it: kit.telemetry.consent in config.yaml, with the legacy telemetry.yaml (bare telemetry.consent) as a read fallback. granted maps to allow, denied to deny, always with an empty subject; decided_at, prompt_version and decision_source carry over. The env precedence of the telemetry resolver still applies to checks: KIT_TELEMETRY_MODE=off and DO_NOT_TRACK are a standing deny, KIT_TELEMETRY_CONSENT overrides the record. Revoke clears the block in both files, other keys kept.

scenarios.name: a canonical granted record is an allow grant
scenarios.config_yaml:
other: keep
kit:
  telemetry:
    consent:
      state: granted
      decided_at: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
      prompt_version: 1
      decision_source: prompt

scenarios.name: a legacy-only record is read in place and left untouched by reads
scenarios.legacy_yaml:
telemetry:
  consent:
    state: denied
    decided_at: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    prompt_version: 1
    decision_source: flag

scenarios.name: the canonical record shadows the legacy one
scenarios.config_yaml:

scenarios.name: a telemetry grant writes the legacy-compatible block and keeps siblings
revoking a legacy-only record clears it in place so the revoke sticks

    decided_at: "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z"
